sources.title: Time-series cyclic aging data on 48 commercial NMC/graphite Sanyo/Panasonic UR18650E cylindrical cells
sources.verifiedFacts: RWTH publishes 48 same-type, same-profile cells with BOL and repeated RPT data under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: One-shot battery degradation trajectory prediction with deep learning
sources.verifiedFacts: The experiment continued beyond 80% EOL; full early capacity histories, rather than one scalar response, were used to forecast complete trajectories.

sources.title: Forecasting battery capacity and power degradation with multi-task learning
sources.verifiedFacts: Capacity and internal-resistance histories were jointly modeled; the paper links EOL80 strongly to the later capacity knee rather than to a single early capacity level.

sources.title: Non-destructive degradation pattern decoupling for early battery trajectory prediction via physics-informed learning
sources.verifiedFacts: Multistep charging excitations were used to infer temporally resolved thermodynamic and kinetic parameters, motivating richer identifiable responses rather than a single early fade scalar.

sources.title: Changepoint detection as a light data-driven approach to battery state-of-health prediction
sources.verifiedFacts: The study reuses the 48-cell RWTH cohort and treats degradation changepoints as informative structure; it is not an independent cohort for RC55 confirmation.

sources.title: The future of battery data and the state of health of lithium-ion batteries in automotive applications
sources.verifiedFacts: The paper argues that capacity and internal resistance alone may not sufficiently describe battery state and highlights increasing trajectory variability despite similar initial grading.

sources.title: Probabilistic machine learning for battery health diagnostics and prognostics—review and perspectives
sources.verifiedFacts: Cell-to-cell manufacturing variability and time-varying use conditions require uncertainty-aware prognostics; deterministic point forecasts alone do not represent this variance.

noveltyBoundary: RC55 does not claim the first use of early capacity or resistance for lifetime prediction. Its distinct contribution is a preregistered, sparse two-coordinate falsification test on an untouched same-condition subset, with interval-censored EOL, abstention for an absent 10 ms signal, and independent numerical reproduction.
